name: Conservative Q-Learning (CQL)
summary: Learn offline reinforcement learning policies under dataset-to-policy action distribution shift.
summary_zh: 通过保守价值正则化抑制离线数据分布外动作的Q值高估。
core_idea: Regularize Q-values to discourage overoptimistic estimates on unsupported actions.
innovation: Addresses severe offline-RL extrapolation errors when new risky exploration is unavailable.
limitations: A policy learned from historical clinical data needs strong confounding and safety assessment.

start_here.why: Landmark conservative offline RL value-learning algorithm.
start_here.focus: Conservative Q regularizer and distribution shift motivation.

curation_note: Representative publication checked; recommendations are advisory and application-specific clinical claims require separate evidence.
